combo_label: Things That Beep × At the Funfair × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Sworn brotherhood of one trade, fixing prices and vetting every apprentice
Haunting figure whose name is borrowed by the fair's rattling dark ride
Gas behind the glowing signs above every ride
Bottle-shaped pit reached only by a trapdoor, where a prisoner was left to rot
Outwork before the gate that funnelled attackers into a killing ground
Wall speaker at the building entrance that crackles and squawks 'Who is it?'
Drum ride that pins you to the wall as the floor drops away
Enclosed yard inside the outer wall, holding stables, forge and storehouses
Field labourer tied to the land, handed on with it whenever it changed owners
Kitchen box that reheats leftovers, then beeps until you come back and apologise.
Ear-splitting AWOOGA! horn beloved of old cartoons and emergency drills.
Box that dings at each floor while playing music nobody has ever hummed
Tumbling laundry machine that sings out when your towels are toasty.
